summary: Performance-driven Director of Information Technology with 27+ years of experience leading IT operations, project management, and strategic initiatives in municipal environments. Proven track record in cost reduction, system optimization, and high‑availability infrastructure.
certifications: Certified Chief Information Officer (CIO) – UNC‑Chapel Hill, November 2005

experience.title: Director of Information Technology

Implemented VoIP, city‑wide fiber optic network, and online payment systems.
Implemented virtualized server environment and business continuity site.

experience.title: Network Services Manager
responsibilities: Managed Desktop Services Division including Help Desk, LAN, server administration, training, and leasing.
Implemented client‑server environment with Microsoft Exchange.
Installed 900+ workstations ahead of schedule and under budget.
Created custom Helpdesk Request application with satisfaction surveys.

experience.title: Data Communications Analyst
responsibilities: Installed, maintained, and configured data communication equipment for the City of Greensboro.
Managed IBM Mainframe, VAX systems, and servers.
Authored operations manual for IBM Mainframe.

experience.title: Electronics Technician
